<a id="maxbounds"></a>

### maxBounds

```ts
maxBounds: number;
```

Maximum domain side length in simulation units. Infinity leaves growth unlimited.
Power-of-two grids round this limit down. Escaped particles are not confined by it.

<a id="priority"></a>

### priority?

```ts
optional priority?: number;
```

Execution phase:
negative is permanent before movement,
0–1 is transient before movement,
1 or greater is transient after movement.
